# Pesher Habakkuk Column 7 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Pesher Habakkuk Column 7 where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 7:5 — "youths, adults, and the aged"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "youths, adults, and-the-aged" | Literal tricolon |
| LOGOS | "youths, adults, and the aged" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "young men, grown men, the elderly" | Dynamic synonyms |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET/LOGOS "youths, adults, and the aged." Standard rendering; PNEUMA's "elderly" is acceptable but "the aged" matches the Hebrew register.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 7:10-11 — "reply to my complaint" vs. "answer regarding my complaint" vs. "respond to my complaint"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "what I-shall-reply to-my-complaint" | Literal Hebrew |
| LOGOS | "what I shall answer regarding my complaint" | Formal; "regarding" clarifies |
| PNEUMA | "how I should respond to my complaint" | Dynamic restructuring |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "what I shall answer regarding my complaint." Clearer English syntax than EMET; PNEUMA changes "what" to "how."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 7:17 — "fulfillment" vs. "consummation" vs. "when the end would come"
| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the-fulfillment-of the-end-time" | Literal for Hebrew qets |
| LOGOS | "the consummation of the end-time" | Elevated register |
| PNEUMA | "when the end would come" | Dynamic paraphrase |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS "the consummation of the end-time." More precise theological term; PNEUMA loses the nominal construction.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---
*Total disagreements in Column 7: 3 | Covers Hab 1:17-2:2*
